reviews.title: Great Power Supply, No Issues
reviews.comment: Very quiet, cable management is easy, plug ‘n’ play, compatible with my 9070 XT Reaper and Asus B650E-E Tuf Gaming Wi-Fi AMD AM5 ATX motherboard. The cables feel very nice and durable. The best part about it is not having to worry about having extra cables you don’t need. Definitely invest in a power supply in this range. It’s a very normal sized power supply and will fit fine is a regular build.
reviews.author: Brian Rostro

reviews.title: Elite quality psu for worry free gaming.
reviews.comment:
Great psu, I have had evga, and corsair psu's in the past. This has a better build quality, better cables (sleeved). And the fan is so quiet i thought it wasn't running or broken, until i used a flash light to see it spinning. I am glad nzxt make such high quality psu's for a great price.
I am running a 9950x3d and a 5070. I will update in a year for longevity.
